analyst.summary: NESCO owns and operates a large Mumbai exhibition-and-IT-park real estate complex, running near-full occupancy with blue-chip multinational tenants, alongside a small engineering business. Revenue has grown strongly, but profit growth has slowed this year as the company invests in new capacity, funded partly by its first meaningful borrowings in years. The core annuity business remains high quality and reasonably priced; the near-term margin dip looks like a capex-driven pause rather than a red flag, but is worth watching until the new capacity starts contributing to profit.
